document_title: Process Characterization Plan — Anion Exchange Chromatography (Step 8)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: AEX sets one CQA (cumulative MVM clearance); the other QualityAttribute entities are the CQAs it controls/clears (formed/introduced upstream).
Flow-through-pool HCP and step-LRF are in-process/modular responses; captured via StudyDesign.responses.
The Plan states classification is an OUTPUT; parameter_type left 'unclassified' here.

process_steps.description: Flow-through anion-exchange polishing: the final chromatographic step of the process. Sets the cumulative MVM (parvovirus) viral-clearance claim and is a major clearance step for enveloped virus (XMuLV), HCP, residual DNA and leached Protein A. The product transmits while impurities and virus bind.

source_references.quote: This plan defines the Stage 1 process characterization study for the anion exchange chromatography step of the A-Mab drug substance process, Step 8 of the purification train.
the commercial anion exchange column
The study will be executed on a scale-down model of the commercial anion exchange column, qualified under SOP-1001.
Cambridge, MA (Development)
Grafton, WI (Commercial DS)

source_references.quote: Pool host cell protein will be measured by ELISA (AMV-3012)
Residual DNA will be measured by qPCR (AMV-3014)
leached Protein A by ELISA (AMV-3016)
Infectivity of xenotropic murine leukaemia virus will be measured by TCID50 (AMV-3017)
infectivity of minute virus of mice by TCID50 with a qPCR confirmation (AMV-3018)
A full factorial in these parameters estimates every main effect and every two-factor interaction without confounding
The same parameters will be studied in a face-centred central composite design of 28 runs.

Qualification will compare the model against commercial-equivalent runs on step yield, pool host cell protein, residual DNA, leached Protein A, the pressure across the bed and the shape of the flow-through peak.
Operating flow rate was assigned to a univariate assessment

statements.statement_text: PCP-008 defines the process characterization study for the A-Mab anion-exchange polishing step (Step 8).

source_references.quote: Purpose and scope This plan defines the Stage 1 process characterization study for the anion exchange chromatography step

statements.statement_text: Five process parameters are characterized; four are studied in the multivariate DoE and the flow rate univariately.

source_references.quote: Table 7 lists the parameters, their set-points, the range that will be studied, the normal operating range and the study type assigned in RA-001.

statements.statement_text: The study uses a full-factorial screen followed by a face-centred central-composite design on a scale-down column.

source_references.quote: The same parameters will be studied in a face-centred central composite design of 28 runs.

statements.statement_text: Anion exchange sets the cumulative parvovirus (MVM) clearance claim and also governs XMuLV clearance, HCP, residual DNA and leached Protein A.

source_references.quote: The step sets one critical quality attribute

statements.statement_text: The study must establish a multivariate operating region over which every governed response is predicted to stay within its acceptance criterion.

source_references.quote: The multivariate operating region will be declared over the part of the characterized region in which every governed response meets its criterion simultaneously.
